author: The Current
description:
Watch and listen to jeremy messersmith’s original song, “Sky Ride” 
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Inspired by the aerial tramway at the Minnesota State Fair, singer-songwriter jeremy messersmith wrote this original song, “Sky Ride,” during his time as the special State Fair Correspondent on The Current Morning Show in the Afternoon.

LYRICS
I stood in line for the Sky Ride. 
I had a time of my life in the Sky Ride
Sky Ride

Not too fast and not too slow, 
Not too high, but not too low,
Gets you where you want to go,
But back to where you started from 

Didn't really change my life. 
Staring down from a medium height, 
Overall it was just all right. 
I don't know what I thought would happen 

I stood in line for the Sky Ride. 
I had the time of my life
On the Sky Ride 
Sky Ride

Credits
Music and lyrics – jeremy messersmith
Performed by @jeremymessersmith 
Video – Luke Taylor
Additional video – Sam Stroozas
Audio mastering – Cameron Wile
title: Watch jeremy messersmith's “Sky Ride,” a song inspired by the Minnesota State Fair #mnstatefair
